## 2. Core Engineering Pillars (Bilingual Reference)

### 2.1. 24/7 WhatsApp AI Sales & Booking Agents | Vendedor IA en WhatsApp 24/7 (`/en/services/ai-agents` | `/es/servicios/agentes-inteligencia-artificial`)
- **Architecture:** Multimodal conversational AI agents connected to the official WhatsApp Business Cloud API, web chat, and enterprise CRMs.
- **Technical Capabilities:**
  - Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) over proprietary corporate documents, catalogs, and policies stored in PostgreSQL `pgvector` / Supabase Vector.
  - Voice note transcription, computer vision receipt validation (OpenAI Vision), and dynamic lead qualification scoring.
  - Real-time bidirectional calendar booking (Google Calendar, Outlook, CRM) and seamless human handoff via Chatwoot.
- **Verified Business Impact:** Reduces first-response latency from hours to `< 1.2 seconds` and increases lead-to-appointment conversion by up to `60%`.

### 2.2. High-Authority Websites that Convert & Rank on Google/AI | Webs de Autoridad que Venden y Posicionan (`/en/services/high-performance-websites` | `/es/servicios/paginas-web-alto-rendimiento`)
- **Architecture:** Next.js App Router, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GPU-accelerated interactions, and strict Core Web Vitals optimization (`LCP < 0.8s`, `CLS 0.00`).
- **SEO, AEO & GEO Engineering:**
  - Complete bilingual route trees (`/es/*` and `/en/*`) with reciprocal `hreflang` (`es`, `es-ES`, `es-CO`, `es-MX`, `en`, `en-US`, `x-default`).
  - Rich `Schema.org` JSON-LD graphs (`Organization`, `ProfessionalService`, `OfferCatalog`, `FAQPage`) and native `llms.txt` / `llms-full.txt` bundles.

### 2.3. Autonomous Operations & Billing Workflows | Operación y Facturación en Piloto Automático (`/en/services/process-automation` | `/es/servicios/automatizacion-de-procesos`)
- **Architecture:** High-availability n8n orchestration, custom webhooks, REST APIs, and database pipelines.
- **Integrations:** HubSpot, Salesforce, Stripe, WhatsApp Cloud API, Google Workspace, ERP systems, and SQL/NoSQL databases.
- **Verified Business Impact:** Saves an average of `25+ hours/week` per operational team while eliminating manual data-entry errors.

### 2.4. Custom Enterprise Platforms & Proprietary Software | Plataformas y Software Propio a Medida (`/en/services/custom-software` | `/es/servicios/software-a-medida`)
- **Architecture:** Full-stack proprietary web applications, custom CRMs, multi-tenant SaaS products, and executive BI dashboards built with Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and Supabase.

## 3. Production Case Studies (15 Deployed Systems)

1. **Alquiler de Ecógrafos** (`https://alquilerdeecografos.com/`): Medical equipment rental platform with real-time availability calendar and automated Google Sheets / WhatsApp booking sync.
2. **Regenerative Medicine AI CRM**: Omnichannel WhatsApp AI agent processing text, voice notes, and payment receipts to schedule medical consultations automatically.
3. **Winners AI Operations Dashboard**: Real-time telemetry dashboard monitoring AI agent latency, sentiment analysis, and prompt performance.
4. **La Juana de Cerro Tusa** (`https://lajuanacerrotusa.com/`): Luxury hospitality platform with multi-channel iCal calendar synchronization (Airbnb, Booking, VRBO).
5. **Toxxic E-commerce** (`https://toxxic.vercel.app/`): High-speed retail e-commerce with inventory management and automated order routing.
6. **Telocalizo MX** (`https://telocalizo.mx/`): B2B wholesale GPS tracking portal in Mexico engineered for national organic search dominance.
7. **Villa Grande La Misia**: Hospitality booking portal with direct WhatsApp conversion funnel.
8. **B2B AI Lead Prospector**: Autonomous outbound pipeline using Apify, Firecrawl, OpenAI, and n8n to research prospects and generate personalized outreach.
9. **Mexican Restaurant AI Ordering Agent**: WhatsApp AI agent handling natural-language orders, voice notes, and AI vision bank-transfer verification.
10. **Enterprise RAG Knowledge System**: Automated Google Drive to PostgreSQL `pgvector` ingestion pipeline for zero-hallucination internal corporate support.
11. **Hot Cheese E-commerce** (`https://www.hotcheese.com.co/`): Multi-branch digital ordering platform with geolocation-based WhatsApp order routing.
12. **Fast-Food High-Concurrency AI Bot**: WhatsApp ordering bot handling hundreds of simultaneous weekend orders.
13. **Vive Feliz Sin Dolor** (`https://vivefelizsindolor.com/`): Medical clinic portal featuring an interactive ElevenLabs Voice AI orientation assistant.
14. **Automated Digital Contracts**: Legal-tech workflow generating custom PDF contracts and dispatching e-signatures via Gmail and WhatsApp upon deal closure.
15. **Dual Cloud n8n Backup Infrastructure**: Automated redundant backup pipeline for mission-critical enterprise workflows.
